metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (TypeScript) with deployable entry point (Dockerfile CMD), dependency manifest (package.json), and resource-provisioning IaC (CloudFormation for ECS Fargate). Single service.
metadata.archetype_justification: PostgreSQL database connections with write operations (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE), CRUD REST endpoints for order entities, entity lifecycle management (status: placed/shipped/cancelled/refunded), and user-specific data (customer_id).

findings.title: Managed Databases — RDS failover configuration not verifiable
findings.description: PostgreSQL 15 on RDS (managed) per README. Database credentials managed via Secrets Manager. RDS resource definition not in this repo's IaC, so automated failover cannot be confirmed.
findings.gap: RDS instance definition not in this repo's IaC — cannot confirm Multi-AZ failover or HA settings.
findings.recommendation: Include the RDS instance definition in IaC with explicit Multi-AZ enabled, automated backups, and encryption configuration.

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration — multi-step operations hardcoded
findings.description: Refund and cancel operations involve multi-step coordination (DB update + external service call) with no orchestration. Sequential async/await calls with no retry, compensation, or state machine structure.
findings.gap: Multi-step operations are hardcoded with no error handling between steps. External call failure after DB update leaves system inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: Introduce Step Functions for refund and cancel workflows to provide retry logic, error handling, and compensation.

findings.title: Async Messaging — no messaging for cross-service state changes
findings.description: No messaging infrastructure. State changes crossing service boundaries (refunds to payment processor, cancellations to warehouse) are synchronous calls. No SQS, SNS, EventBridge, or messaging SDK.
findings.gap: Tight synchronous coupling between orders service and downstream services. Cascading failures and no retry mechanism for cross-service state propagation.
findings.recommendation: Introduce SQS or EventBridge for state-change notifications. Publish order events (OrderRefunded, OrderCancelled) for async downstream processing.

findings.title: Network Security — no security groups in IaC
findings.description: ECS tasks deployed with AssignPublicIp: DISABLED (private subnets). However, no security groups defined in CloudFormation. No VPC endpoints or managed networking services.
findings.gap: No security groups defined — relying on defaults. No VPC endpoints for service-to-service communication. No network segmentation between tiers.
findings.recommendation: Add security group definitions with least-privilege ingress rules. Add VPC endpoints for ECR, Secrets Manager, and CloudWatch.

findings.title: API Entry Point — ALB not defined in IaC
findings.description: README references ALB but no ALB resource defined in the CloudFormation template. No API Gateway, AppSync, or CloudFront. No gateway-level throttling or request validation.
findings.gap: Entry point infrastructure not defined in this repo. No gateway-level throttling, request validation, or WAF protection.
findings.recommendation: Include ALB definition in IaC with health checks. Consider API Gateway for throttling and WAF integration.

findings.title: Auto-Scaling — static capacity, no scaling policies
findings.description: No auto-scaling configuration. ECS Service uses static DesiredCount: 2 with no scaling policies or Application Auto Scaling resources.
findings.gap: Static capacity cannot respond to traffic spikes or scale down during low demand.
findings.recommendation: Add Application Auto Scaling for ECS service with target tracking on CPU utilization or request count.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery — no backup configuration
findings.description: No backup configuration in the repository. RDS instance not defined in IaC, so backup_retention_period and PITR cannot be confirmed. No AWS Backup plans.
findings.gap: No documented or codified backup strategy for order data (includes customer PII).
findings.recommendation: Define RDS in IaC with backup_retention_period >= 7 days, PITR enabled. Document and test restore procedures.

findings.title: High Availability — database Multi-AZ unconfirmed
findings.description: ECS service runs 2 tasks across multiple subnets. Database Multi-AZ cannot be confirmed from in-repo evidence (RDS not defined here).
findings.gap: Cannot confirm database Multi-AZ. No explicit HA documentation or verification for the full stack.
findings.recommendation: Define RDS with MultiAZ: true in IaC. Ensure SubnetIds span at least 2 AZs.

findings.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage — partial (~40%)
findings.description: CloudFormation defines ECS Cluster, TaskDefinition, IAM Role, ECS Service, Secrets Manager Secret. Not in IaC: RDS, ALB, security groups, auto-scaling, CloudWatch alarms, Route53.
findings.gap: Significant infrastructure dependencies not managed as code. Environment reproducibility and disaster recovery compromised.
findings.recommendation: Expand IaC to cover RDS, ALB, security groups, auto-scaling policies, and CloudWatch alarms.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation — no pipeline exists
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline definitions found. No GitHub Actions, buildspec.yml, Jenkinsfile, GitLab CI, or CodePipeline in IaC. All deployments are manual.
findings.gap: All application and infrastructure deployments are manual. No automated build, test, lint, or deploy stages.
findings.recommendation: Create CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions or CodePipeline) with lint → build → test → security scan → deploy stages.

findings.title: Async vs Sync Communication — all synchronous
findings.description: All inter-service communication is synchronous. WarehouseClient calls (issueRefund, recallDispatch) are direct synchronous await. No message publishing, no event-driven handlers, no queue consumers.
findings.gap: All cross-service state propagation is synchronous with no async patterns. Cascading failure risk for refund and cancel operations.
findings.recommendation: Publish order state change events to EventBridge or SQS. Downstream services consume events asynchronously.

findings.title: Long-Running Process Handling — no async job processing
findings.description: External service calls (payment processor, warehouse) are handled synchronously inline with no async fallback, status polling, or callbacks.
findings.gap: No async handling for external service calls with unpredictable latency. Slow downstream service blocks HTTP request.
findings.recommendation: Accept refund/cancel requests with HTTP 202, process asynchronously via SQS or Step Functions, provide status polling endpoint.

findings.title: API Versioning Strategy — no versioning mechanism
findings.description: No API versioning. Endpoints use unversioned paths (/orders, /orders/{id}). No URL path versioning, no version headers. OpenAPI spec has version 2.1.0 but no consumer-facing mechanism.
findings.gap: Breaking API changes would affect all consumers simultaneously with no migration path.
findings.recommendation: Adopt URL path versioning (e.g., /v2/orders). Establish versioning policy for backward-incompatible changes.

findings.title: Service Discovery — environment variables only
findings.description: External service endpoints configured via environment variables (JWKS_URI). No dynamic service discovery, no service mesh, no API catalog.
findings.gap: No dynamic service discovery. Endpoint changes require redeployment with new environment variables.
findings.recommendation: Register service in AWS Cloud Map or use ECS Service Connect for dynamic endpoint resolution.

findings.title: Unstructured Data Storage — no object storage capability
findings.description: No S3, object storage, or unstructured data handling. Service stores only structured order data in PostgreSQL. No document storage or parsing capabilities.
findings.gap: No unstructured data storage capability. No object storage foundation for order attachments, receipts, or invoices if needed.
findings.recommendation: If unstructured data needs exist (order receipts, invoices), add S3 bucket configuration in IaC with lifecycle policies.

findings.title: Unified Data Access Layer — business logic mixed with data access
findings.description: All database access centralized in OrderService class. Routes delegate to OrderService. However, business logic (refund processing, warehouse coordination) is mixed with data access (raw SQL) in a single class.
findings.gap: Business logic and data access co-located. No separate repository/DAO abstraction layer.
findings.recommendation: Extract a dedicated OrderRepository class for SQL queries. Keep OrderService focused on business logic.

findings.title: Database Engine Version — not pinned in IaC
findings.description: README states PostgreSQL 15 (current, not EOL). However, engine version is not pinned in IaC — no RDS resource definition exists. Version documented informally only.
findings.gap: Database engine version not enforced through infrastructure code. No version-update procedure documented.
findings.recommendation: Define RDS in IaC with explicit EngineVersion: '15'. Document version-update procedure.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest — not verifiable from in-repo evidence
findings.description: Database stores customer PII (customer_id, order data). No KMS key configuration visible. RDS not defined in this repo, so encryption status cannot be confirmed.
findings.gap: No encryption configuration visible for database storing customer PII.
findings.recommendation: Define RDS in IaC with StorageEncrypted: true and customer-managed KMS key with rotation policy.

findings.title: API Authentication — no gateway-level throttling
findings.description: JWT RS256 bearer tokens on all endpoints with JWKS validation and role enforcement. Service in private subnets. No API Gateway-level throttling or request validation.
findings.gap: No gateway-level throttling or request validation. Authentication solely at application layer.
findings.recommendation: Add API Gateway or ALB authentication integration for throttling, request size limits, and WAF protection.

findings.title: Secrets Management — no rotation configured
findings.description: Database credentials in Secrets Manager with auto-generated passwords. Injected via ECS Secrets. No hardcoded credentials. No rotation configured.
findings.gap: No automated secret rotation for database password.
findings.recommendation: Add rotation configuration with RDS-compatible rotation Lambda and 30-day interval.

findings.title: Compute Hardening — no vulnerability scanning
findings.description: Fargate manages host patching. Container uses node:20-slim, multi-stage build, non-root USER node. No vulnerability scanning or dependency-update automation configured.
findings.gap: No container image scanning or dependency vulnerability scanning. No automated dependency updates.
findings.recommendation: Enable ECR image scanning. Add Dependabot or Renovate for automated dependency updates.

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline — no security scanning
findings.description: No security scanning tools. No CI/CD pipeline exists. No Dependabot, no SAST, no container scanning, no npm audit in scripts.
findings.gap: No automated security validation. Vulnerabilities reach production undetected.
findings.recommendation: Integrate npm audit, SAST (Semgrep), and ECR image scanning into CI/CD pipeline. Add .github/dependabot.yml.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing — not instrumented
findings.description: No distributed tracing. No OpenTelemetry SDK, no X-Ray, no trace propagation. Structured logging with request IDs only.
findings.gap: Cannot trace requests across service boundaries. Debugging distributed call chain requires manual log correlation.
findings.recommendation: Add OpenTelemetry SDK with X-Ray exporter. Instruments Fastify, pg, and outbound HTTP automatically.

findings.title: SLO Definitions — none defined
findings.description: No SLO definitions. No CloudWatch alarms. No latency, error-rate, or availability monitoring configured.
findings.gap: No formal definition of acceptable service levels. Cannot measure service health or degradation.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs: availability 99.9%, p99 latency <500ms reads / <2s writes, error rate <0.1%. Add CloudWatch alarms.

findings.title: Business Metrics — none published
findings.description: No custom business metrics. Only default CloudWatch Logs from ECS container output. No orders_created, refunds_issued, or cancellation_rate metrics.
findings.gap: Cannot track business outcomes. Infrastructure metrics alone do not indicate business value delivery.
findings.recommendation: Publish custom CloudWatch metrics for order counts, refund amounts, cancellation rates. Add business KPI dashboard.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting — none configured
findings.description: No alerting. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration.
findings.gap: Production issues invisible until users report them. No automated detection of error spikes or latency anomalies.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for error rate, p99 latency, 5xx responses. Enable anomaly detection on primary endpoints.

findings.title: Deployment Strategy — rolling with circuit breaker, no traffic shifting
findings.description: ECS Service uses rolling deployment with DeploymentCircuitBreaker (Enable: true, Rollback: true). Automatic rollback on failure but no canary or blue/green traffic shifting.
findings.gap: No traffic-shifting strategy. All traffic switches simultaneously during rolling update — no gradual rollout.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to CodeDeploy blue/green with traffic shifting (10% canary for 5 minutes before full cutover).

findings.title: Integration Testing — no tests committed
findings.description: No test files in the repository. vitest configured as dev dependency with test script but no *.test.ts or *.spec.ts files committed. No CI pipeline to run tests.
findings.gap: No verifiable test coverage. Changes cannot be validated before deployment. Regression risk unmanaged.
findings.recommendation: Commit integration tests for order lifecycle using vitest with test PostgreSQL container. Include in CI pipeline.

findings.title: Incident Response Automation — no runbooks
findings.description: No runbooks, automation documents, or incident response configuration. No SSM Automation, no Lambda remediation.
findings.gap: Incident response entirely ad hoc. No documented procedures for common failure modes.
findings.recommendation: Create runbooks for database connection failure, downstream timeout, high error rate, and deployment rollback.

findings.title: Observability Ownership — no ownership defined
findings.description: No CODEOWNERS file, no per-service dashboards, no alarms with named owners, no team attribution on monitoring resources.
findings.gap: No accountability for observability gaps. No designated owner for monitoring improvements.
findings.recommendation: Add CODEOWNERS file. Create CloudWatch dashboard with team ownership tags. Define alarm owners.

findings.title: Resource Tagging Governance — no tags on resources
findings.description: No resource tags on any CloudFormation resources. ECS Cluster, TaskDefinition, Service, IAM Role, and Secrets Manager Secret all lack tags.
findings.gap: Cannot track costs per service, identify ownership during incidents, or enforce budget controls.
findings.recommendation: Add consistent tags (Service, Environment, Team, CostCenter) to all CloudFormation resources.
